answer: EigenTrust derives centrality from normalized peer endorsements, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits unsupported trust loops. An exponential temporal half-life continually discounts stale reputation, requiring sustained honest service to maintain influence. Freshly spawned sybil identities lack trusted support and therefore begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality; names such as basalt, canyon, and zephyr cannot pass consensus simply by endorsing one another.
